name: APPSADM UTM Widgets for Elementor
author: Justo Vargas

sections.description:
This lightweight plugin adds two free Elementor widgets for marketers and campaign managers:

  1. UTM Smart Welcome – Shows a custom message based on the visitor’s UTM source.
  2. Sticky CTA Button – Displays a floating CTA that adapts based on UTM parameters.

The widgets are easy to customize and perfect for improving user engagement from specific campaigns.

Upgrade to the Pro version for access to 5 more advanced marketing widgets.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it via the Plugins menu.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen.
  3. Drag the new widgets from the “APPSADM – UTM Widgets” section in Elementor.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with the free version of Elementor?

Yes, all widgets included in this version are compatible with both the free and pro versions of Elementor.

What widgets are included in this version?

This free version includes two marketing-focused widgets:
1. Smart UTM Welcome Message
2. Sticky CTA with dynamic behavior

Do I need any extra plugin to use this?

Only Elementor (free or pro). No other dependencies are required.

Can I upgrade to more widgets later?

Yes. The PRO version includes 5 extra marketing widgets and can be upgraded at any time without losing your current settings.

Is there a live demo or documentation?

Yes. Visit https://appsadm.com/widgets-lite for full usage instructions and examples.

Is this plugin compatible with multilingual sites?

Yes. All dynamic texts can be translated, and we recommend using tools like WPML or TranslatePress.
